definitions.explanation: The first part of autumn, roughly corresponding to September in Japan. Often still warm, with the first hints of cooler weather.

examples.japanese: {初秋|しょしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧。
examples.english: The early autumn breeze is pleasant.

examples.japanese: {初秋|しょしゅう}⟦とはいえ→とはいえ：06282_tohaie⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Although it's early fall, the hot days continue.

examples.japanese: {初秋|しょしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Around early autumn, the color of the sky begins to change little by little.

notes:
A literary and seasonal word used in writing, haiku, and weather reports. Part of a series of seasonal divisions: {初秋|しょしゅう} (early), {仲秋|ちゅうしゅう} (mid), ⟦{晩秋|ばんしゅう}→晩秋：08561_banshuu⟧ (late autumn). The same pattern applies to other seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初秋|しょしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: early autumn breeze
- {初秋|しょしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: the early autumn season (epistolary)
- {初秋|しょしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: the early autumn sky

RELATED SEASONAL TERMS:
- {仲秋|ちゅうしゅう}: mid-autumn — the middle period, associated with the harvest moon
- ⟦{晩秋|ばんしゅう}→晩秋：08561_banshuu⟧: late autumn — the final stretch before winter
- ⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧: early summer — the same pattern applied to summer
- ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧: start of autumn — a specific date in the traditional calendar (around August 7)
